findings.summary: https://de-linker.com/de/produkte/ renders LC DT ID: 6905 (vorlage-fur-archiv-fur-beitragstyp-produkt) instead of 6961 (shop-page).
findings.root_cause: livecanvas/modules/templating.php:51-79 evaluates is_archive() first (resolving DE archive template 6905) before is_shop() returns false because 6961 has pll_lang=en and no DE twin; Linker\I18n\DynamicTemplates::template() (plugins/linker-i18n/includes/DynamicTemplates.php:90-93) returns early whenever $template_id is truthy, so it never falls back to 6961 on /de/produkte/.

evidence: GET https://de-linker.com/de/produkte/ -> 200, <!-- LC DT ID: 6905 --> (DEFECT: expected 6961 per effective_languages=['en','de'])
reason: EN /products/ 及其排序/分页命中 LC DT ID: 6961；但实测发现 DE /de/produkte/ 实际渲染 LC DT ID: 6905 而非 6961（is_archive 抢先赋值导致 DynamicTemplates::template 提前返回），记录为模板绑定缺陷并脱离 pending。
